entry.author: commercecommission
entry.summary:
Our first State of Competition report provides an evidence-based assessment of how competition is working across New Zealand’s economy.

The report draws on a detailed analysis of 22 years (2001-23) of Stats NZ data from individual businesses to establish baseline competition measures for future monitoring. 

It gives us the clearest view yet of how competition is working across the economy and provides a positive foundation to build on.

Our State of Competition report, along with an at-a-glance summary, the underlying dataset and media release, can be found on our website: https://www.comcom.govt.nz/about-us/research/state-of-competition-report-in-new-zealand
